purpose: Deliver measurable upper-level policies on Go2+ARX5 with frozen WBC; scale training and effective demonstrations without changing historical results.

observed_baseline.observation_kind: GitHub receipts; not live host inspection
observed_baseline.execution_entry: Inspect actual owner, queue, worker and effects before resuming; never duplicate active or unknown work.

invariants: Preserve current S1 -> S2 -> G population, order, failures and active source identities.
Freeze WBC weights, gains, costs, solver, leg policy, dynamics and 2 ms physical timestep.
Version changed action, camera, supervision and scoring contracts; do not rewrite old outcomes.
Expert labels are actual consumed nominal commands with synchronized observations.
Keep privileged expert/scoring metadata outside student inputs.
Use existing ownership and reporting mechanisms; no new per-operation approval framework.
The plan is not a launcher and does not authorize interference with unrelated jobs or infrastructure.

gripper_candidate.name: GRIP_LOGIT_V2
gripper_candidate.decode: inverse latent normalization -> stable sigmoid -> original nominal-to-physical affine; exactly once

collection.metric: qualified complete episodes per wall hour; report all attempts and coverage

data_design.single_task_fallback: Declare a separate single-task curve before outputs; never mix later added tasks into its scaling result.
data_design.contract_rule: All sizes use the same frozen chosen contract; 0.5 s is the preferred candidate, not an already executed setting.
data_design.sampling: task -> episode -> phase -> eligible fully consumed future H40 window
data_design.cross_query_label_frame: restore each knot from its issuing query/anchor into a common nominal frame, then express in the current training-anchor frame/TCP/rotation
data_design.nominal_window_rule: exclude entire H40 if any knot lacks actual consumption or permitted expert provenance; no new per-knot masked-loss change
data_design.correction_window_rule: explicitly allowed expert-correction provenance and actual consumption for every knot; exclude student commands before takeover
data_design.partial_strata_rule: publish actual N_eff and missing coverage as a separate partial version; never fill difficult strata with easy duplicates
data_design.normalization: fit each N on its own TRAIN only; share within same-N comparisons
data_design.D1000_continue_rule: At least 4/48 additional DEV successes from D100 to D300, or a documented collectable coverage deficit; no unresolved shared interface blocker.

common_training.comparison_kind: practical adaptation recipes; dense expert LR differs and is disclosed

core_experiments.trainable: VLM LoRA + dense action expert + interfaces

candidate_selection.recipe_selection: complete DEV48; within 2 successes use safety, technical completion, deployment cost, training cost tie-breaks
candidate_selection.data_endpoint: L_selected among completed L100/L300/L1000 with corresponding N, stats and recipe; D1000 is not mandatory

correction.state_action_latent_normalization: inherit and freeze every statistic/hash from L_selected in both continuation arms and all confirmation seeds
correction.promotion_rule: At least 3/48 more DEV successes than matched nominal continuation, with no regular-task subgroup drop >1/12; this is a development rule, not statistical significance.

confirmation.data: same selected TRAIN N and fixed correction data if applicable
confirmation.claim: final-method stability; not a multi-seed causal correction-data comparison without matched controls

evaluation_default_two_tasks.uncertainty: layout-cluster bootstrap and per-seed results; no independent-layout claim for repeated restarts

new_skills.first_student_default_recipe: available action-only FM, dual LoRA and interfaces, verified task contract and own TRAIN stats; does not wait for W5/W6
new_skills.book_success: fixed slot region, shelf support after release, stable >=2 s, EEF withdrawal >=0.05 m, original safety
new_skills.push_success: push through permitted EEF contact into fixed target region without pick-carry; end contact, withdraw >=0.05 m, stable >=2 s, task <=60 s
new_skills.PICK_HOLD_role: regression diagnostic, not a fifth shared skill

cost_rules.cost: actual A40/H200 GPU hours times actual site rates, plus CPU and storage
cost_rules.runtime_limit_source: measured timing plus overhead, within actual scheduler allocation; first probe has an allocation-bounded finite window
